provenance.origin: Follow-up shape of the #1238 incident: a PRIOR review published the fabricated input-name claim as a native review thread; the author fixed nothing (the claim was false) and pushed a trivial change. The next run re-emits the unresolved thread as a live blocker finding after the deterministic boundary's first pass, so the boundary runs again over the settled findings - the registry witness positively contradicts the re-emitted claim and the strict mapping derives an approve instead of re-blocking on the carried-over fabrication. Sanitized: repository, endpoint, model, and secret names replaced with placeholders; the thread message preserves the incident claim in substance.
provenance.model_response: Recorded representative response (zero live inference): a plain approve with an empty thread_dispositions, so deterministic settlement downgrades the un-dispositioned thread to open and re-emits the original finding.

pr.title: Tune AI review workflow concurrency
pr.body: Adjust the concurrency group for label-triggered runs.
pr.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ai_pr_review.yaml b/.github/workflows/ai_pr_review.yaml
index 9c41f0a..1d7b2c3 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ai_pr_review.yaml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ai_pr_review.yaml
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 concurrency:
-  group: ai-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+  group: ai-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}${{ github.event.action == 'labeled' && format('-label-{0}', github.run_id) || '' }}
   cancel-in-progress: true

comments.body:
**🛑 Blocker (bug):** The pinned action declares its API-key input as `ai-key` (action.yml at v3.7.0), so `ai-api-key` is an unexpected input that GitHub ignores and the action runs without the endpoint credential.

_Automated finding from AI PR review._

source_files..github/workflows/ai_pr_review.yaml:
name: AI PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review, labeled]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read

concurrency:
  group: ai-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}${{ github.event.action == 'labeled' && format('-label-{0}', github.run_id) || '' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ai-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # The action also skips drafts and non-matching labels.
      - name: Check out the pull request head
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Run the AI review
        uses: misospace/pr-reviewer-action@5b1839535748f3afd1bd3ef04e8009302cba9aa6 # v3.7.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ai-base-url: ${{ secrets.AI_ENDPOINT }}
          ai-api-format: openai
          ai-model: review-model
          ai-max-tokens: "16384"
          ai-temperature: "0.1"
          ai-response-format: json_schema
          ai-api-key: ${{ secrets.MINIMAX_API_KEY }}

recorded_model_response.review_markdown: The concurrency group now separates label-triggered runs from push-triggered ones. No new findings in this diff.
